title: vatica lanceolata
intro: Vatica lanceolata, commonly known as the Borneo ironwood or ulin, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of wounds and infections. The therapeutic actions of Vatica lanceolata include its antioxidant and anti-cancer properties, which can help protect against cell damage and prevent the growth of cancer cells. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
